articles.title: Finish library search box
articles.summary: Search the finish library by name, description or #tag. It is a text box.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > FINISHES library (full-screen). Search finishes by name, description, id, metadata, aliases, or hashtag-style terms like #chrome, #carbon, and #weathered. Hint inside the box: Smart search titles, descriptions, ids, or #tags.

controls.label: Finish library search box
controls.effect: Search the finish library by name, description or #tag

pitfalls: Try plain words ("gold chrome") or hashtags (#carbon).

combos.why: Works together with the Finish picker search box control.

articles.title: Color: AUTO
articles.summary: Color Lock: when ON, picking a finish keeps your current colour instead of adopting the finish's default. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > zone editor > Base Material picker (popup). Color Lock: when ON, changing the base/finish keeps your current zone color instead of auto-applying the finish's default color.
when: Colour keeps changing when you change finish.

controls.label: Color: AUTO
controls.effect: Color Lock: when ON, picking a finish keeps your current colour instead of...

combos.why: Works together with the Lock (Base Color lock) control.

articles.title: Finish picker search box
articles.summary: Search finishes in the base picker by name, idea or #tag. It is a text box.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > zone editor > Base Material picker (popup). Search bases, finishes, patterns, descriptions, ids, aliases, and hashtag-style terms such as #chrome, #carbon, #weathered, #matte, or #color-shift. Hint inside the box: Search titles, descriptions, ids, or #tags.
when: Find a finish for the zone.

controls.label: Finish picker search box
controls.effect: Search finishes in the base picker by name, idea or #tag

combos.why: Works together with the Surprise me control.
